scope: Independent read-only review of the exact QA observer/test patch and immutable original test logs. No duplicated tests, Android run, source edit or central ref change by this reviewer.
conclusion: No concrete blocker found in the reviewed two-file patch. A fresh separately bound real-device diagnosis is still required; this does not accept the failed original 6b Android run.
preserved_contracts: run()/main() suffix is byte-identical, including exact build/source/native/APK identity gates.
All 34 existing test methods are AST-identical; nine additional observation/deadline/byte-preservation cases are present.
The Village verifier, capture/OCR readers, Flutter entropy helper and live accessibility reader are byte-identical.
The single real native Spiele touch and its two stable source frames are retained. The new observer issues no UI input, rotation or relaunch.

Every attempt captures a new exclusively named original in its own directory; rejected PNGs/TSVs remain. Only a validated accepted PNG is copied with exclusive creation to the established canonical filename, followed by byte-hash verification.
Exact Spielen OCR and original TSV/component/tile source replay remain mandatory. Native Spiele is never accepted as Spielen.
Same host PID, ended native process and resumed MainActivity are checked before and after image/OCR/semantics, and profile preservation remains replayed by the unchanged final verifier.
Enabled package-bound Flutter Spielewelt semantics remain required alongside current pixels. Caption alone is insufficient.

The local acceptance budget is the existing combined 30-second capture plus 60-second OCR allowance, now shared across all attempts and process/XML/hash/copy work. Each capture remains <=30s, each OCR <=60s, within the unchanged 900-second roundtrip deadline.
Clock checks occur before and after blocking observations and after the final copy/hash; a successful result at or beyond the deadline is rejected.

live_xml_limitation.original_reader: scripts/probes/pr207_android_ui_probe.py:live_nodes uses uiautomator2.dump_hierarchy; creative_android_probe.read_live_nodes wraps its existing retries.
live_xml_limitation.review: The unchanged reader does not accept a caller timeout. The wrapper checks before and after the call, so it cannot accept a late XML result. Actual wall-clock return can exceed the 90-second acceptance deadline while that existing call blocks. This is disclosed, not represented as cancellation of a still-running RPC.

fallback_review: image_lines records source.name, source SHA and surface. Each attempt and canonical copy use returned-flutter-frame.png as basename; the copied bytes are identical. This preserves the unchanged component/tile source-name, pixel and TSV-offset replay. New explicit tests cover both fallback paths.
